theorems.name: Submission.allard52_am_cc_profile_integral_continuousAt
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (y : Amb n ℓ) (f : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (S T t : ℝ), IntegrableOn f (closedBall y S) μ → Continuous g → 0 < T → (∀ u : ℝ, T < u → g u = 0) → 0 < t → T * t < S → ContinuousAt (fun s => ∫ x, g (‖x - y‖ / s) * f x ∂μ) t
